Every game. One screen.

Bring your own browser tabs. Open your games in Chrome or Edge, then click Add a stream and choose a game under Chrome Tab or Microsoft Edge Tab. Enable tab audio in the sharing dialog. Use the player’s fullscreen button in the source tab to fill its tile. Mute the original tabs to avoid duplicate audio; click Listen here to hear one through this viewer. Capture support varies by site. Nothing is recorded or uploaded.

LET’S ADD A GAME

Your game. Three easy steps.

  1. Open your gameGo to the browser tab with your game and press play.
  2. Click FanDeckClick our icon next to the address bar. If you don’t see it, look in the puzzle-piece Extensions menu.
  3. You’re ready to watchYour game appears here. Repeat to add another. Click any game to hear it.

Keep your game tabs open while you watch.
